name: iso
title: The ISO 9001:2015 / ISO 27001:2022 evidence profile
law: An evidence map, not a certificate. Each clause names the govstruct surface that can evidence it and the gate that proves it; each refusal code names the clause it bears on and the corrective action. govstruct certifies nothing - it emits the records an auditor would ask for.

standards.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - Information security management systems - Requirements

themes.context: clauses about the organization and the scope of the system
themes.leadership: clauses about policy, roles, and responsibility
themes.support: clauses about resources and documented information
themes.operation: clauses about running the process and controlling output
themes.performance: clauses about monitoring, audit, and review
themes.improvement: clauses about nonconformity and continual improvement

clauses.title: Quality management system and its processes
clauses.requires: determine the processes needed, their inputs, outputs, sequence, and interaction
clauses.surface: the manifest: members, roles, needs[] edges, topo-sorted order
clauses.resolution: declare the member as a block in members/; the graph is derived, never hand-drawn

clauses.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
clauses.requires: assign, communicate, and understand responsibilities and authorities
clauses.surface: member role + grants[] (the governed credential kinds)
clauses.resolution: a role outside the enum, or a grant kind outside the vocabulary, is a refusal - fix the block

clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
clauses.requires: plan actions to address risks and opportunities, and evaluate their effectiveness
clauses.surface: the refusal registry: every known failure mode has a named code and a resolution
clauses.resolution: a refusal code with no clause resolution is E_ISO_RESOLUTION_MISSING - map it, do not ship it

clauses.title: Creating and updating documented information
clauses.requires: documented information is created, updated, and controlled for adequacy and suitability
clauses.surface: compliance/<id>.json blocks + the rendered surfaces (apps.json, registry.json)
clauses.resolution: a rendered surface that drifts from the manifest is E_SUITE_DRIFT - regenerate, never hand-edit

clauses.title: Control of documented information
clauses.requires: documented information is available, protected, retained, and disposed of as needed
clauses.surface: the lock receipt (horcrux/ + sha256) and the append-only audit ledger
clauses.resolution: a missing or drifting checksum is E_CHECKSUM_MISSING / E_CHECKSUM_DRIFT - re-lock, never overwrite the archive

clauses.title: Control of externally provided processes, products and services
clauses.requires: control externally provided processes, products and services so they conform
clauses.surface: the pin ledger: companion spec floors, engine pins, and action SHAs
clauses.resolution: a pin-style or pin-version drift is E_ADOPTER_PIN_STYLE_DRIFT / E_ADOPTER_VERSION_DRIFT - pin the exact served version

clauses.title: Control of production and service provision
clauses.requires: production is carried out under controlled conditions
clauses.surface: the doctor: author-time refusal of a drifted rendering
clauses.resolution: the doctor refuses by name; the fix is the named field, not a re-run

clauses.title: Identification and traceability
clauses.requires: identify process outputs and retain evidence of traceability where necessary
clauses.surface: the traveler: content-derived address, append-only ledger, pin ledger, tamper-refuse
clauses.gate: govstruct audit verify && govstruct verdict verify
clauses.resolution: a broken chain is E_LEDGER_BROKEN / E_LEDGER_TAMPER / E_LEDGER_SEQ_GAP - history is append-only; never rewrite it

clauses.title: Control of changes
clauses.requires: review and authorize changes, and control them so the system stays conforming
clauses.surface: the source-consistency check: a change is applied everywhere or refused
clauses.resolution: a partial change is E_SUITE_DRIFT - apply it everywhere the surface is declared

clauses.title: Release of products and services
clauses.requires: verify that product requirements are met before release
clauses.surface: the verdict bus: a member's status receipt, chained and verifiable offline
clauses.resolution: a red or stale receipt is E_RECEIPT_CHAIN / E_RECEIPT_UNKNOWN_MEMBER - emit a fresh receipt, never assert green

clauses.title: Control of nonconforming outputs
clauses.requires: identify and control nonconforming outputs so they are not released
clauses.surface: the shared refusal registry (spec/refusals.json), typed codes
clauses.resolution: an unregistered code is E_REFUSAL_UNREGISTERED - register it or do not emit it

clauses.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
clauses.requires: determine what to monitor, how, when, and evaluate the results
clauses.surface: the fleet meter (doctor --suite --fleet): one drift page over the live fleet
clauses.resolution: a fleet drift is E_FLEET_* - the meter names the member, the field, and the delta

clauses.title: Internal audit
clauses.requires: conduct internal audits at planned intervals against the requirements
clauses.surface: the adopter gate: every declared adopter at a pinned rev
clauses.resolution: a missing or drifting adopter is E_ADOPTER_MISSING / E_ADOPTER_VERSION_DRIFT - declare it and pin it, or remove the claim

clauses.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
clauses.requires: react to nonconformity, evaluate the need for action, and review effectiveness
clauses.surface: each drift is a typed refusal with a clause and a fix (this profile's resolutions map)
clauses.resolution: every refusal code carries a clause and an action here; a gap is E_ISO_RESOLUTION_MISSING

clauses.title: Continual improvement
clauses.requires: continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the system
clauses.surface: the audit ledger: an append-only record that only grows, never rewrites
clauses.resolution: improvement is recorded as a new entry; the chain proves nothing was removed to get there

clauses.title: Policies for information security
clauses.requires: define, approve, publish, and review information security policy
clauses.surface: govstruct.config.json + the manifest: policy as versioned data
clauses.resolution: policy that is code-shaped is reviewable as a diff; drift is a refusal, not a silent change

clauses.title: Information security for use of cloud services
clauses.requires: establish processes to govern the use of cloud services
clauses.surface: the pin ledger: every external dependency recorded at an exact version
clauses.resolution: an unpinned or ranged dependency is a pin-style drift - pin the exact version

clauses.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards
clauses.requires: verify compliance with the organization's security policies and standards
clauses.surface: the suite truth battery: every member checked against its declared block
clauses.resolution: a member that disagrees with its block is E_SUITE_DRIFT - the block is the contract

clauses.title: Documented operating procedures
clauses.requires: document operating procedures and make them available to those who need them
clauses.surface: the CLI verbs + the docs tree (docs/, generated from site.config.js)
clauses.resolution: a docs page missing its frontmatter or a link is a hard failure - fix the page

clauses.title: Privileged access rights
clauses.requires: restrict and manage allocation of privileged access rights
clauses.surface: grants[]: who may spend which credential kind, scoped
clauses.resolution: a grant outside the governed kinds is E_GRANT_UNKNOWN_KIND - widen the vocabulary deliberately or drop it

clauses.title: Access to source code
clauses.requires: manage access to source code, development tools, and libraries
clauses.surface: the manifest's grants + the write path (stamp)
clauses.resolution: a stamp that widens a wall is E_GRANT_UNLISTED - the grant must already be declared

clauses.title: Configuration management
clauses.requires: establish and control configurations, including security configurations
clauses.surface: govstruct.config.json is the single config source; the manifest is the single roster
clauses.resolution: config that is malformed is E_CONFIG_INVALID / E_CONFIG_MISSING - the config is required input

clauses.title: Logging
clauses.requires: produce and retain logs of activities, exceptions, and events
clauses.surface: labs/audit-ledger.jsonl: append-only, chained, tamper-evident
clauses.resolution: a tampered or broken ledger is E_LEDGER_TAMPER / E_LEDGER_BROKEN - the chain is the evidence

clauses.title: Networks security
clauses.requires: secure, manage and control networks and network devices
clauses.surface: the url contract: every declared url is absolute https (the doctor refuses http)
clauses.resolution: a url served over http is E_URL_INSECURE - serve it over tls, or fix the declared url

clauses.title: Monitoring activities
clauses.requires: monitor networks, systems, and applications for anomalous behaviour
clauses.surface: the fleet meter + the verdict rollup: the live suite read and reported
clauses.resolution: a stale verdict is E_RECEIPT_CHAIN - poll fresh, never assert green from a stale receipt

clauses.title: Use of cryptography
clauses.requires: define and implement rules for the effective use of cryptography
clauses.surface: content-addressed ledger entries (sha256 chain) and the lock receipt
clauses.resolution: a checksum that moved without a version bump is E_CHECKSUM_DRIFT - bump or re-lock

clauses.title: Secure development life cycle
clauses.requires: establish and apply rules for secure development of software and systems
clauses.surface: the milestone ladder (PRD section 15) + the per-member lifecycle history
clauses.resolution: a lifecycle that walks backward is E_HISTORY_BACKWARD - the ladder is forward-only

clauses.title: Application security requirements
clauses.requires: identify, specify, and approve information security requirements for applications
clauses.surface: the compliance/<id>.json block: floors, env contract, pins, versions
clauses.resolution: a member with no compliance block has no declared requirements - declare it

clauses.title: Secure coding
clauses.requires: apply secure coding principles to software development
clauses.surface: the hygiene-shapes and comment-shapes check packs (no secret, no stray log)
clauses.resolution: a leaked secret or a stray debugger is a hygiene finding - remove it at the source

clauses.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
clauses.requires: define and implement security testing processes in the development life cycle
clauses.surface: crashtest: the adversarial battery over real handlers, recorded in labs/crashledger.json
clauses.resolution: a new EXPLOITED finding fails CI - fix the handler or docket the bound with a reason

clauses.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
clauses.requires: separate development, testing, and production environments
clauses.surface: the tier rig (public/private/local) and the in-memory test backends
clauses.resolution: a test that touches production is a separation failure - keep the fake env fake

clauses.title: Change management
clauses.requires: subject changes to change management procedures
clauses.surface: the doctor + the audit ledger: a change is a reviewable diff and a recorded action
clauses.resolution: an unreviewed change is a refusal - land it as a diff the doctor can see

clauses.title: Test information
clauses.requires: select, protect, and manage test information appropriately
clauses.surface: fixtures under test/fixtures: synthetic, committed, never real data
clauses.resolution: real data in a fixture is a leak - replace it with a synthetic shape

clauses.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
clauses.requires: plan and agree audit tests that involve assessment of operational systems
clauses.surface: the audit ledger is read-only evidence; audits never mutate the system
clauses.resolution: an audit that writes is a refusal - verify reads, record appends, never rewrites history

clauses.title: People controls (Annex A theme 6) - out of scope
clauses.requires: screening, terms of employment, awareness, disciplinary process, etc.
clauses.resolution: OUT OF SCOPE: a software tool cannot evidence people controls. Named here so the frame states its edge, not silently drops it.

clauses.title: Physical controls (Annex A theme 7) - out of scope
clauses.requires: physical security perimeters, entry controls, equipment protection, etc.
clauses.resolution: OUT OF SCOPE: a software tool cannot evidence physical controls. Named here so the frame states its edge, not silently drops it.

E_A11Y_FAKE_ANCHOR.action: make the menu row a real anchor the keyboard can reach; a div with a click handler is not a link

E_A11Y_NO_FOCUS.action: declare a visible focus ring on the pane; a focusable control with no ring is unusable by keyboard

E_A11Y_NO_LANDMARK.action: give the rendered pane a named landmark (nav/main) so assistive tech can find it

E_ADDRESS_VERSION_UNKNOWN.action: the roll-up addresses a payload schema the tool cannot render; upgrade the reader or re-emit the roll-up at a known schema

E_ADOPTER_MISSING.action: a declared adopter has no checkout pinning govstruct; declare it or remove the claim

E_ADOPTER_MODE_UNKNOWN.action: an adopter's pin mode is outside the governed list; use npm (an exact devDependency) or commit (a pinned git sha)

E_ADOPTER_PIN_STYLE_DRIFT.action: pin the exact version the suite serves, not a range

E_ADOPTER_SHA_INVALID.action: a commit-mode adopter's pin is not a full 40-hex sha; pin the exact commit, never a branch or a short sha

E_ADOPTER_VERSION_DRIFT.action: the adopter's pinned version disagrees with the served version; bump the pin or the suite

E_ALIAS_DUPLICATE.action: an alias collides with a live id or another alias; give each name one owner

E_ALIAS_SELF.action: a member lists its own id as an alias; remove it - an id is not an alias of itself

E_CHECKSUM_DRIFT.action: an emitted artifact moved without a version bump; bump the version or re-lock deliberately

E_CHECKSUM_MISSING.action: an artifact named in the lock has no checksum record; re-lock to restore the receipt

E_CONFIG_INVALID.action: govstruct.config.json is malformed; fix the JSON and the schemaVersion

E_CONFIG_MISSING.action: govstruct.config.json is absent; the config is required input - run govstruct init or write it

E_FIELD_EMPTY.action: a required string field is empty; fill it or remove the field

E_FIELD_MISSING.action: a required field is absent; add it to the member block

E_FIELD_TYPE.action: a field has the wrong type; match the grammar in the manifest module

E_FLEET_CI_SHAPE_DRIFT.action: a member's CI workflow shape disagrees with the suite; align it or declare the difference

E_FLEET_FLOOR_DRIFT.action: a member's node floor disagrees with its compliance row; bump the row or the member

E_FLEET_LOCK_MISSING.action: a member in the fleet has no lock receipt; run govstruct lock in that member

E_FLEET_PIN_STYLE_DRIFT.action: a fleet pin is a range, not an exact version; pin the exact version

E_FLEET_VERSION_DRIFT.action: a fleet member's version disagrees with the suite roll-up; reconcile the two

E_GRANT_DUPLICATE.action: a grant is listed twice; remove the duplicate

E_GRANT_SCOPE_EMPTY.action: a grant carries no scope; give it the narrowest scope that works

E_GRANT_UNKNOWN_KIND.action: a grant kind is outside the governed vocabulary; widen the vocabulary deliberately or drop it

E_GRANT_UNLISTED.action: a stamp tried to spend a grant the member never declared; declare the grant first

E_HISTORY_BACKWARD.action: the lifecycle walked backward; the ladder is forward-only - a retired member is not resurrected

E_HISTORY_INVALID.action: a history entry is malformed; each is { status, at, note? } with a known status

E_HISTORY_MISMATCH.action: the member's status disagrees with its last transition; make them agree

E_HOME_UNKNOWN.action: a member's home names a non-member; point it at a real member or null

E_I18N_NO_FALLBACK.action: a chrome string has no locale fallback; declare the default locale

E_I18N_UNKEYED.action: a chrome string is unkeyed; key every user-visible string

E_ICON_MISSING.action: a member declares an icon that does not exist; add the asset or fix the name

E_ID_DUPLICATE.action: an id is declared twice; ids are unique

E_ID_FORMAT.action: an id is not kebab-case; rename it

E_ID_MISMATCH.action: an id does not match its filename; make them agree

E_ID_MISSING.action: a member block has no id; add one

E_IMPACT_UNKNOWN_MEMBER.action: impact was asked about a non-member; use a real id

E_ISO_CLAUSE_UNKNOWN.action: a clause id is not in the ISO profile catalog; use a catalogued clause id or add the clause

E_ISO_PROFILE_MISSING.action: the ISO profile is absent or malformed; restore spec/iso-profile.json - the orientation is data, not code

E_ISO_RESOLUTION_MISSING.action: a registered refusal code has no clause/action resolution; map it in the ISO profile - an unmapped refusal is an unactioned nonconformity

E_ISO_SURFACE_MISSING.action: an in-scope clause names no surface or no gate; give it one or mark it out of scope - a clause with no evidence is a claim

E_LEDGER_BROKEN.action: the audit ledger chain is broken; history is append-only - restore from a receipt, never patch a line

E_LEDGER_RECEIPT_DANGLING.action: a ledger entry points at a receipt that is absent; re-emit the receipt

E_LEDGER_SEQ_GAP.action: the ledger sequence has a gap; a gap is a refusal - the chain must be contiguous

E_LEDGER_TAMPER.action: a ledger entry's address does not match its body; the ledger was rewritten - restore the original

E_MEMBERS_DIR_MISSING.action: the members directory does not exist; create it and add blocks

E_MEMBER_INVALID_JSON.action: a member block is not valid JSON; fix the syntax

E_NEEDS_CYCLE.action: the dependency graph has a cycle; break it - the order must be derivable

E_NEEDS_SELF.action: a member depends on itself; remove the self-edge

E_NEEDS_UNKNOWN.action: a member needs a non-member; add the member or drop the edge

E_NETWORK_DISABLED.action: a network check ran without --network; opt in explicitly - the default posture is no socket

E_NPM_MISSING.action: a member declares an npm name that is unclaimed; claim it or fix the name

E_ORDER_COLLISION.action: two members share an order value; give each a distinct order

E_ORDER_MISSING.action: a member has no order; add a non-negative integer

E_PACK_INVALID.action: a check pack is malformed; fix its pack.json and entry per the packstruct SPEC

E_PENDING_INVALID.action: a member's pending annotation is malformed; use { resources: [...], interim?, note? } with a non-empty resource list

E_PENDING_UNKNOWN.action: a pending annotation names a resource outside the governed list or one the member does not declare; fix the annotation or the record

E_RECEIPT_CHAIN.action: a status receipt chain is broken or stale; emit a fresh receipt - never assert green from a stale one

E_RECEIPT_INVALID.action: a receipt is not valid JSON or misses a required field; re-emit it

E_RECEIPT_TAMPER.action: a receipt's address does not match its body; the chain was rewritten - restore the original

E_RECEIPT_UNKNOWN_MEMBER.action: a receipt names a member not in the roster; add the member or fix the receipt

E_REFUSAL_UNREGISTERED.action: a refusal code is not in spec/refusals.json; register it or do not emit it

E_RETIRE_ALIAS_REQUIRED.action: retiring a member needs a forwarding alias; a tombstone that 404s is a lie

E_RETIRE_ALREADY_TOMBSTONED.action: the member is already tombstoned; the lifecycle is forward-only

E_RETIRE_UNKNOWN_MEMBER.action: retire was asked about a non-member; use a real id

E_ROLE_UNKNOWN.action: a role is outside the enum; use a governed role

E_ROLLUP_ETAG_STALE.action: the roll-up ETag is stale; re-emit the roll-up

E_ROLLUP_NOT_CANONICAL.action: the roll-up is not the canonical rendering; regenerate from apps.json

E_SECTION_UNKNOWN.action: a section is outside the enum; use open-source | proprietary | other

E_STAMP_DUPLICATE.action: the member is already stamped; a stamp is idempotent, not additive

E_STAMP_INVALID.action: the stamp record is malformed; fix it against the record schema

E_STAMP_TARGET_EXISTS.action: the stamp target already exists; stamp a fresh id or retire the old one first

E_STATUS_UNKNOWN.action: a status is outside the enum; use a governed lifecycle status

E_SUITE_DRIFT.action: a member disagrees with the suite truth; apply the change everywhere or refuse it

E_SURFACE_CONTRACT_INVALID.action: the surface contract is malformed or a surface payload will not parse; repair the contract or the emitted surface

E_SURFACE_FIELD_MISSING.action: a promised field is absent from an emitted surface; emit it or drop it from the contract deliberately

E_SURFACE_TYPE_DRIFT.action: a promised field changed type; that is a breaking change, so bump the surface schemaVersion and note it

E_SURFACE_UNKNOWN.action: a surface is checked against the contract but is not named in it; add it or stop checking it

E_TEMPLATE_FLOOR_DRIFT.action: a starter template pins a dependency below the floor its compliance block declares; bump the pin or lower the floor deliberately

E_TOMBSTONE_EMPTY.action: a tombstone carries no alias and no history; a tombstone must point at something

E_UNKNOWN_FLAG.action: an unknown flag was passed; check the verb's usage

E_URL_DUPLICATE.action: two members share a url; give each its own home

E_URL_FORMAT.action: a url is not an absolute https url; fix it

E_URL_INSECURE.action: a url is http, not https; serve it over tls

E_URL_UNRESOLVABLE.action: a declared url does not resolve; fix the deploy or the url

E_USAGE.action: the verb was called incorrectly; check usage

packstruct/manifest-missing.action: a pack has no manifest; add pack.json per the packstruct SPEC

packstruct/manifest-invalid.action: a pack manifest is malformed; fix it against the packstruct SPEC

packstruct/schemaVersion.action: a pack manifest carries an unknown schemaVersion; align it to the frozen spec

packstruct/name-kebab-case.action: a pack name is not kebab-case; rename it

packstruct/name-dir-match.action: a pack's declared name does not match its directory; make them agree

packstruct/version.action: a pack manifest carries no version; add one

packstruct/description.action: a pack manifest carries no description; add one

packstruct/entry.action: a pack's declared entry does not exist; fix the path or add the file

crashtest/REFUSED.action: the attack was refused by the handler; the control holds - keep the verdict

crashtest/EXPLOITED.action: the attack succeeded; fix the handler, or docket the bound with a named reason

crashtest/BOUNDED.action: the attack was bounded by config; a bound is a controlled nonconformity - record it, never re-alarm
